## MultipleSequenceAlignmentProps.onRemoveRows property

Enables row removal: the × on a hovered label, and Delete/Backspace on selected rows. Never called with every row — at least one always remains.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onRemoveRows?: (rowIds: string[]) => void;
```
